voice: espeak-ng + MBROLA us2, rate 158, pitch 36, word gap 2

lines.text: If you are seeing this, close your curtains. Now.
lines.beat_before: hook: alert card + tone from frame 0

lines.text: Tonight, at ten forty two, the Moon will rise. Do not look at it.
lines.beat_before: neighbours close curtains; she closes ours

lines.text: Do not take photographs. Do not watch it on a screen.
lines.beat_before: clock 10:39; she glances at the curtains

lines.text: If someone in your home has already looked, do not let them describe what they saw.
Do not answer, if they say it is closer.
lines.beat_before: kitchen dolly: Mark in the yard
handle turns; Mark in the doorway

lines.text: Stay inside. Keep listening, for further instructions.
lines.beat_before: the light over the rooftops; Mark behind her

lines.text: If this message is coming from outside your window,
do not open the curtains to check.
